questions.question: Among the sets in the block "Ice Age", how many of them have an Italian translation?
questions.evidence: tab04 in the block "Ice Age" refers to fld079 = 'Ice Age'; Italian translation refers to fld075 = 'Italian' and fld094 is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T2.fld063 = T1.fld081 WHERE T1.fld079 = 'Ice Age' AND T2.fld075 = 'Italian' AND NOT T2.fld094 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.block = 'Ice Age' AND T2.language = 'Italian' AND T2.translation IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Which foreign language used by "A Pedra Fellwar"?
questions.evidence: "A Pedra Fellwar" refers to fld049 = 'A Pedra Fellwar'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT fld075 FROM tab02 WHERE fld049 = 'A Pedra Fellwar'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

questions.question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
questions.evidence: incredibly poweful foils refers to fld006 is not null AND fld007 is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT fld001 FROM tab01 WHERE NOT fld006 IS NULL AND NOT fld007 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

questions.question: What proportion of cards do not have a text box with a normal layout?
questions.evidence: do not have a text box refers to fld034 = 1; proportion refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(Textless = 1 and fld037 = 'normal'),COUNT(Textless))*100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fld034 = 1 AND fld037 = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM tab01
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM cards

questions.question: What is the percentage of the cards with a converted mana cost of 7 in the set Coldsnap?
questions.evidence: converted mana cost of 7 refers to fld011 = 7; card set Coldsnap refers to fld049 = 'Coldsnap'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld011 = 7), SUM(fld011))*100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.fld011 = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T2.fld081 = T1.fld063 WHERE T2.fld049 = 'Coldsnap'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.convertedManaCost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'

questions.question: Among the cards with converted mana cost higher than 5 in the set Coldsnap, how many of them have unknown power?
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to fld049 = 'Coldsnap'; converted mana cost higher than 5 refers to fld011 > 5; unknown power refers to fld055 = '*' or T1.fld055 is null
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.fld055 = '*' OR T1.fld055 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T2.fld081 = T1.fld063 WHERE T2.fld049 = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.fld011 > 5
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.power = '*' OR T1.power IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.convertedManaCost > 5

questions.question: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.
questions.evidence: pre-modern format refers to fld076 = 'premodern' ;do not have multiple faces refers to fld064 IS NULL
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072 INNER JOIN tab06 AS T3 ON T1.fld072 = T3.fld072 WHERE T2.fld076 = 'premodern' AND T3.fld068 = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1.fld064 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'premodern' AND T3.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1.Side IS NULL

questions.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
questions.evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to fld077 = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(fld077 = 'Banned'))
questions.SQL: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT fld076, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM tab03 WHERE fld077 = 'Banned' GROUP BY fld076 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.fld076, T1.fld049 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T2.fld072 = T1.fld072 INNER JOIN MaxBanned AS MB ON MB.fld076 = T2.fld076 WHERE T2.fld077 = 'Banned'
questions.SQL_original: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'
